1.d4 d5 2.c4 c6 3.Nc3 Nf6 4.e3 g6 5.Nf3.strategy: Develops the bishop where it guards c4 and supports a later e4, and prepares castling. White builds a classical set-up and neither side has committed in the centre.
Castles into safety and brings the rook towards the centre. The king and the fianchettoed bishop stand together, and Black can now turn to the centre and to the still undeveloped c8 bishop.
